avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces prednisone levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal supplements

avoid_supplements.name: Licorice Root (high dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive mineralocorticoid effects increase hypertension and hypokalemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use only under medical supervision; monitor electrolytes

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D
caution_supplements.mechanism: Prednisone impairs vitamin D metabolism; supplementation may be beneficial
caution_supplements.action: Consider supplementation; baseline and periodic 25-OH vitamin D monitoring recommended

caution_supplements.name: Calcium
caution_supplements.mechanism: Prednisone increases bone loss; calcium supplementation supports bone health
caution_supplements.action: Consider supplementation (1000-1200 mg daily) with vitamin D for osteoporosis prevention

caution_supplements.name: Zinc
caution_supplements.mechanism: Prednisone may increase urinary zinc losses
caution_supplements.action: Monitor zinc status; supplement if deficiency suspected

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase prednisone levels and adverse effects
avoid_foods.action: Avoid grapefruit products; use alternative citrus fruits

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Prednisone causes sodium retention and fluid accumulation
caution_foods.action: Limit sodium intake to <2g daily; monitor blood pressure

caution_foods.name: High-sugar/refined carbohydrates
caution_foods.mechanism: Prednisone increases glucose levels and diabetes risk
caution_foods.action: Minimize refined sugars; emphasize complex carbohydrates and monitor glucose

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Increases GI irritation, osteoporosis risk, and infection susceptibility
caution_foods.action: Minimize or avoid alcohol consumption; take prednisone with food

monitoring_notes: Monitor electrolytes (potassium, sodium), blood glucose, blood pressure, and bone density with chronic prednisone use. Assess for drug interactions with CYP3A4 substrates and ensure adequate calcium/vitamin D intake to mitigate osteoporosis risk.
